svg.title: Groups decide which input channels a filter can read; depthwise means one channel each, and only the 1×1 that follows mixes again
svg.desc: Three wiring panels: every input to every filter; two groups with separate colours; one channel per filter followed by a pointwise stage. The weight shape is written under each panel.

g.text: g = 1: every input to every filter
channels in different groups never meet; a later 1×1 layer (or a channel shuffle) is what mixes them again
